mainEntity.name: How many millimetres are in an inch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exactly 25.4. This has been the international definition since 1959.

mainEntity.name: How many feet are in a mile?

acceptedAnswer.text: 5,280 international feet, which is exactly 1,609.344 metres.

mainEntity.name: How do I read a tape measure fraction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The result is the whole inches plus the nearest fraction, such as 9 7/16. Choose 1/32 or 1/64 for finer work.

mainEntity.name: Why does the converter use metres in the middle?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting every unit to metres first and then to the target avoids compounding rounding errors across steps.
